core: Congenital disorder of glycosylation type I
qualifier: dolichol-oligosaccharide glycosyltransferase (ALG/DPAGT1) defects
name: CDG type I from dolichol-oligosaccharide glycosyltransferase defects
rationale: All members are CDG-I diseases caused by defective ALG/DPAGT1 glycosyltransferases that build the lipid-linked oligosaccharide, whereas confusables cover DOLK, PMM2, MPDU1, DPM, MPI and other non-glycosyltransferase or type II defects.

qualifier: hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine and hydroxylation modifications
name: Polyamine metabolism with hypusine, diphthamide and hydroxylation modifications
rationale: Members cover polyamine synthesis, interconversion, oxidation and transport together with specialised spermidine-linked or translation-machinery modifications (hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine, protein hydroxylation), distinguishing it from confusables centred on selenocysteine, tRNA aminoacylation or protein methylation.

qualifier: aminoacylation, cytosolic and mitochondrial
name: tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation
rationale: Members are tRNA end processing, splicing, base modification and aminoacylation in cytosol and mitochondria plus related RNA modification, whereas confusables centre on mitochondrial translation, ribosome assembly or rRNA modification.

qualifier: proliferation, apoptosis, stem-cell maintenance and organ size
name: Kidney development control of proliferation, survival and size
rationale: Members regulate kidney and metanephros development through cell proliferation, mesenchymal survival, progenitor maintenance and kidney size, while confusables cover nephron and ureteric duct morphogenesis and differentiation.

qualifier: nutrient and energy sensing via AKT-TSC and LKB1-AMPK
name: Nutrient- and energy-sensing mTORC1 signalling via AKT and TSC
rationale: Members describe TORC1/2 regulation by amino acids, glucose, energy (LKB1-AMPK) and AKT-TSC with translational output, whereas confusables focus on PTEN regulation and ERBB2:ERBB3 downregulation.

qualifier: macro-, micro- and chaperone-mediated cargo routes
name: Selective autophagy via macro-, micro- and chaperone-mediated routes
rationale: Members are cargo-selective autophagy forms (pexophagy, aggrephagy, receptor-mediated mitophagy, nucleophagy, endosomal microautophagy, CMA) and phagophore cargo targeting, unlike confusables centred on autophagosome maturation control, PINK1-PRKN mitophagy or protein quality control.

core: Urea cycle citrulline and arginine synthesis
qualifier: ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency
name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis and OTC deficiency
rationale: Members are the urea cycle, citrulline/arginine biosynthesis and OTC variant deficiencies, whereas confusables cover other urea cycle enzyme defects, ornithine transport or arginine catabolism.

qualifier: IL-12, IL-23 and IL-10
name: IL-12, IL-23 and IL-10 signalling
rationale: All members are IL-12, IL-23 or IL-10 receptor signalling, distinct from confusables built on IL-17, IL-33/36, IL-15/21 or IL-27/35 signalling.

qualifier: Rho GTPase and EPHB signalling, filopodia
name: Rho/EPHB cytoskeletal control of dendrite and postsynapse structure
rationale: Members regulate actin/microtubule organisation shaping dendrite arborization, spines, filopodia and postsynaptic structure via RHO GTPases and EPHB, whereas confusables add NMDAR-RAC1, reelin, BDNF-TRK and synaptic plasticity.

qualifier: hyaluronan turnover
name: Scavenger receptor uptake and hyaluronan turnover
rationale: Members are ligand scavenging by class A, B, F and H receptors together with hyaluronan synthesis regulation and degradation, while confusables emphasise apoptotic cell clearance, immune complex clearance or oxidised LDL foam-cell responses.

qualifier: execution and its defects, separate from inflammasome assembly
name: Pyroptotic cell death execution and its defects
rationale: All three members are pyroptosis itself or its defective forms, whereas confusables are upstream inflammasomes, caspase-4/5 activation and IL-1 processing.

qualifier: activated CD4 T cells
name: Proliferation of activated CD4 T cells
rationale: All members are blood transcription modules of mitotic cell cycle and division in stimulated CD4 T cells, unlike confusables that are generic G2/M, E2F and DNA replication programmes.

qualifier: primordial germ cells, piRNA and sperm chromatin packaging
name: Germline specification, spermatogenesis and sperm chromatin packaging
rationale: Members span germ-cell specification, spermatogonial maintenance, spermatogenesis, piRNA retroelement control and sperm/pronuclear chromatin remodelling, whereas confusables centre on maternal-to-zygotic transition and piRNA-directed heterochromatin.

qualifier: drug, nicotine and alcohol reward behaviour
name: Dopamine receptor signalling in drug and alcohol reward behaviour
rationale: Members combine dopamine/nicotinic/opioid receptor signalling with behavioural responses to cocaine, nicotine, ethanol and amphetamine and reward conditioning, whereas confusables cover monoamine transport/synthesis or neuropeptide-driven behaviours.

qualifier: assembly, intraflagellar transport and motility
name: Cilium and sperm flagellum assembly, trafficking and motility
rationale: Members cover centriole/basal body formation, intraciliary transport, ciliary cargo targeting, axonemal dynein assembly, motile cilia function and sperm flagella, distinguished from confusables on kinesins, tubulin modification, retinal development or mitotic centrosomes.

qualifier: keratinocyte migration with adhesion and matrix disassembly
name: Epithelial and keratinocyte migration via adhesion and matrix disassembly
rationale: Members regulate epithelial and keratinocyte migration, focal adhesion and extracellular matrix disassembly and EGF response, whereas confusables emphasise wound-healing proliferation, inflammation or Rho/Rac adhesion inhibition.

qualifier: Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic and Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members concern GPCR control of cAMP through Gi/Gz-mediated adenylate cyclase inhibition, notably alpha-2 adrenergic, unlike confusables on adrenaline inhibition of insulin secretion or muscarinic/PDE signalling.

qualifier: stomach motility, acid secretion and development
name: Gastrointestinal motility, gastric acid secretion and stomach development
rationale: Members concern stomach and intestinal smooth muscle contraction, gastric acid secretion and stomach development, while confusables cover enteric nervous system development, general/urogenital smooth muscle or serotonin receptors.

qualifier: centromeric cohesion and its resolution
name: Centromeric sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
rationale: All members concern maintaining centromeric sister chromatid cohesion and resolving it for separation, distinct from confusables on spindle checkpoint, spindle assembly or APC/C activity.

core: ER membrane organization and lipid transfer
qualifier: phospholipid flipping and scrambling
name: ER membrane shaping with phospholipid transfer, flipping and scrambling
rationale: Members cover ER tubular network formation, membrane fusion and tethering together with intermembrane phospholipid transfer, flippase/scramblase translocation and PI synthesis, whereas confusables emphasise mitochondrial contacts, phosphoinositide synthesis or glycolipid transport.

qualifier: base excision gap filling and error-prone translesion synthesis
name: Base excision repair gap filling and error-prone translesion synthesis
rationale: Members are polymerase-driven gap filling in single-nucleotide and long-patch BER and PCNA-dependent translesion synthesis by REV1, POLI and POLK, distinct from confusables on glycosylases/mismatch repair, replication or NER with POLH.

qualifier: proliferation, differentiation and fusion in growth and regeneration
name: Myoblast differentiation and fusion in muscle growth and regeneration
rationale: Members regulate myoblast commitment, proliferation, migration, differentiation and fusion in skeletal muscle growth and regeneration, whereas confusables emphasise satellite-cell maintenance, atrophy or negative regulation of muscle development.

qualifier: tetrahydrobiopterin, pyridoxal phosphate and molybdenum cofactor
name: Tetrahydrobiopterin, pyridoxal phosphate and molybdenum cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members concern synthesis of the cofactors BH4, PLP and molybdopterin plus processes depending on them (BH4-dependent phenylalanine hydroxylation/PKU, Moco-dependent sulfite oxidation), unlike confusables on serine, transsulfuration, selenium or tyrosine catabolism.

qualifier: PLC- and beta-arrestin-coupled dopamine receptor signalling
name: Dopaminergic transmission via PLC and beta-arrestin receptor signalling
rationale: Members regulate dopaminergic synaptic transmission and dopamine receptor signalling via phospholipase C and beta-arrestin, whereas confusables carry adenylate cyclase-coupled dopamine receptor signalling and drug behaviours.

qualifier: Na+/K+-ATPase and Ca2+-activated/TRESK K+ channels
name: Na+/K+-ATPase and potassium channel control of membrane potential
rationale: Members maintain Na+/K+ gradients, resting potential and action potentials via P-type ATPases (glycoside-sensitive) and Ca2+-activated and TRESK K+ channels, distinct from confusables on other K2P/KATP channels or sodium transport regulation.
